title: Model Cache Manifest
description: Schema for the model-cache-init container manifest file. Describes bundles to download and optionally extract during pod initialization.

version.description: Semver version of the manifest format

models.description: List of model/data files to download

path.description: Relative path within cache directory for the downloaded file

md5.description: Expected MD5 checksum (null if not available)

extract.description: Whether to extract the archive after download (tar.gz supported)

extract_target.description: Relative path within cache directory for extraction target (required when extract=true)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this bundle contains
